name: Principles of Computer Vision
description:
The "Principles of Computer Vision" lecture deals with the image formation 
process from radiometric properties of surfaces (Lambertian surfaces, specular 
surfaces) over camera models and lens systems to basic calibration and image 
processing techniques. It teaches the basic knowledge that is necessary for 
binocular 3D-and multi-view reconstruction. 
Topics 
- reflection properties of surfaces 
- camera parameters 
- camera calibration 
- filtering techniques (noise reduction, edge detection, etc.) 
- segmenting and clustering algorithms 
- image domains (RGB, YUV, HSV, disparity) 
- catadioptric camera systems (advanced image formation techniques) 
- high resolution systems (mosaicing, point spread techniques) 
- advanced segmentation techniques
